actor-start.eventDescription: Flat fee charged once per run, covering the feed downloads.

article.eventDescription: One deduplicated article row: title, publisher, resolved publisher URL and Google link, ISO publication time, snippet, query or topic, edition.

article-text.eventDescription: Body text and meta description extracted from the publisher's page. Charged only when 'Fetch article text' is enabled and text was actually extracted; blocked, paywalled or empty pages are not charged.
